_note: Optional real dog recordings for Kathmandu Streets. Put CC0 / public-domain audio files (mp3 or ogg) in this folder and list them here, e.g. {"file": "dog-bark-1.mp3"} or {"file": "big-dog-woof.mp3", "big": true}. Up to 8 files. When the list is empty the game uses its built-in modelled bark.
